questions.q: At the start of the chapter, was Phileas Fogg behind schedule?
choices: Yes, he was already two days behind
No, he was not yet behind-hand
Yes, by the twelve hours lost to the buffalo
No, he was a full week ahead of his plan
questions.evidence: Phileas Fogg was not as yet behind-hand.

questions.q: What did Colonel Proctor say from behind Mr. Fogg during the whist game?
choices: "I should play a diamond."
"You have cheated, sir!"
"Give me your seat at once."
"That card is not yours."

questions.q: When the colonel interrupted, what did Mr. Fogg do with his card?
choices: He calmly threw down the ten of spades anyway
He changed his mind and played a diamond instead
He tore up the card and left the game in anger
He handed his cards to Fix and walked away
questions.evidence: replied Phileas Fogg coolly, throwing down the ten of spades

questions.q: Why did Fix stand up and speak to Colonel Proctor?
choices: He wanted to arrest the colonel for causing trouble
He tried to make the quarrel his own, since he had been struck
He wanted to ask the colonel to join their game
He hoped the colonel would delay Fogg in America
questions.evidence: it was I whom you not only insulted, but struck

questions.q: When did Mr. Fogg first suggest that he and the colonel should meet?
choices: The next morning
Six months later
In ten years' time
That same evening
questions.evidence: Will you appoint a meeting for six months hence?

questions.q: The colonel cried, "All this is an evasion." What does he mean by evasion?
choices: A way of avoiding something
A polite kind of promise
A clever kind of trick in cards
A warning to call the police

questions.q: Where did the colonel say they should settle the quarrel?
choices: At Omaha, the end of the line
At Plum Creek, the next station
In Chicago, where the colonel lived
At Fort Kearney, beside the soldiers

questions.q: What did Mr. Fogg do after agreeing to the meeting?
choices: He wrote a long letter to the Reform Club
He calmly went back to the interrupted game
He asked the conductor to put the colonel off
He hid in the baggage car until Plum Creek
questions.evidence: Mr. Fogg resumed the interrupted game with perfect calmness.

questions.q: Why could the two men not get off the train at Plum Creek?
choices: The station was closed because of the snow
The train was twenty minutes late and would not stop
Aouda locked the door of the car to stop them
Soldiers on the platform would not let them off
questions.evidence: We are twenty minutes late, and we shall not stop.

questions.q: What did the conductor suggest instead of stopping?
choices: That they wait to settle it at Omaha
That they settle it in the last car as the train went on
That they shake hands and forget the quarrel
That they settle it with another game of whist
questions.evidence: why not fight as we go along?

questions.q: The passengers in the last car left it "with alacrity." What does alacrity mean?
choices: Slowly and with many complaints
Quickly and willingly
Angrily, shouting at the conductor
Sadly, leaving their bags behind
questions.evidence: The passengers granted the request with alacrity

questions.q: What interrupted the duel before it began?
choices: The colonel changed his mind and apologised
The train was attacked by a band of Sioux
The bridge ahead broke and the train stopped
Aouda ran into the car and begged them to stop
questions.evidence: the train was attacked by a band of Sioux

questions.q: Why was the locomotive rushing forward faster and faster?
choices: The engineer wanted to reach Omaha quickly
A chief opened the steam-valve wide by mistake
The track ran steeply downhill to the river
Passepartout had added too much coal to the fire
questions.evidence: had opened wide instead of closing the steam-valve

questions.q: How did Passepartout manage to stop the train?
choices: He climbed onto the engine and pulled the brake
He crept under the cars and freed them from the engine
He ran along the roof and signalled the soldiers
He jumped off and threw a log across the rails
questions.evidence: he made use of his old acrobatic experience

choices: Everyone is safe and the train goes on to Omaha
Passepartout, who saved the train, is found missing
Fogg and the colonel finish their duel at the fort
Fix is arrested by the soldiers waiting at Fort Kearney
questions.evidence: among others the courageous Frenchman, whose devotion had just saved them
